articles.summary: Record-breaking IPO for company behind Claude comes amid tumbling prices for other AI stocks. Plus why the humble potato could be vital for future space missions Good morning. Global stock markets have slumped as Anthropic’s record-breaking IPO failed to stem a sell-off in AI-linked companies. The sell-off followed losses on Wall Street on Thursday, where the main indices all fell by over 2% on a day dominated by Anthropic’s IPO. The blockbuster debut easily places Anthropic’s IPO as the biggest in history, with the 980m shares sold raising $81bn, surpassing the previous record.
